title: The Quebrada de Humahuaca and the Calchaquí valleys: a road through the Andes

sections.title: Can you do this?
items: I can set one fact against another with *sin embargo* and *no obstante* (*la quebrada es seca; sin embargo, allí viven comunidades*).
